templates.pattern: A man enters a windowless room with nothing but a rope and dies by hanging. Room is empty except for puddle. How?
templates.explanation: He stood on a block of ice to hang himself. Ice melted, leaving puddle

templates.pattern: A man calls his wife from his car and says he'll be late. When he arrives home, she's dead and stranger is there. Why no alarm?
templates.explanation: Wife went into labor. Stranger is the doctor/midwife who delivered the baby. Wife died in childbirth

templates.pattern: A woman is afraid to go home because a man with a mask is waiting. Who is the man?
templates.explanation: She's playing baseball. Man with mask is the catcher at home plate

templates.pattern: Man tells truth on Mon, Tue, Wed and lies other days. Woman lies on Thu, Fri, Sat and tells truth other days. Both say 'Yesterday I lied.' What day?
templates.explanation: Only Thursday works: Man (lies Thu, Wed he told truth so 'I lied' is a lie). Woman (tells truth Thu, Wed she lied so 'I lied' is truth)

templates.pattern: A man is found dead hanging from ceiling fan 10 feet up. No furniture nearby. Only puddle under him. What happened?
templates.explanation: Similar to classic: stood on melting ice block or dry ice

templates.pattern: Five people at dinner. One dies after eating. Food wasn't poisoned. No one killed them. What happened?
templates.explanation: Person choked on food or had severe allergic reaction. Death by accident, not poison or murder

templates.pattern: Man in desert finds cabin. Inside are 53 bicycles and dead man. What happened?
templates.explanation: Not bicycles - Bicycle brand playing cards. 53 cards (52 + joker). Man caught cheating at cards

templates.pattern: Man lives on island. Every night light appears across water. One night it doesn't. He kills himself. Why?
templates.explanation: He was lighthouse keeper. Thought his light saved ships. Light out meant he thought a ship crashed because of him

templates.pattern: A man walks into an art museum, looks at painting, and immediately knows his wife is cheating. How?
templates.explanation: Painting shows his wife with another man, or shows something only cheater would know about

templates.pattern: Two people sit across table. One pushes penny to other who refuses. First person knows second is millionaire. How?
templates.explanation: Offering penny stock investment or asking for 'thoughts' (penny for your thoughts) from consultant

templates.pattern: Man buys new car. Drives 5 minutes, stops, never drives again. Car is fine. Why?
templates.explanation: He's a car salesman doing a test drive with customer. Sold the car after 5 minutes

templates.pattern: Woman falls from 50-story building. Lands on ground. Gets up and walks away. How?
templates.explanation: She fell from 50-story building's ground floor window (inches). Or construction worker fell 50 stories worth of progress (ground level)

templates.pattern: Man receives package. Opens it. Screams. Calls police to confess murder from 20 years ago. What was in package?
templates.explanation: Package contained evidence he thought was destroyed. Realized he'd be caught, confessed

templates.pattern: Surgeon says 'I can't operate, that's my son!' But surgeon isn't the boy's father. Obvious answer is mother. What's another?
templates.explanation: Boy has two fathers (gay couple). The surgeon is the other father

templates.pattern: Man is born in 1955, today is 2024, but he's only 30 years old. How?
templates.explanation: 1955 is hospital room number, not birth year. Or born 1955 BC (ancient times)

templates.pattern: Five assassins in elevator. One floor later, all dead except one who didn't move. What happened?
templates.explanation: Survivor held breath or had gas mask. Others died from poison gas someone released

templates.pattern: Man reads newspaper obituary of himself. Smiles. Next day actually dies. Connection?
templates.explanation: Faked his death for insurance/escape. Smiled at success. Then actually died by coincidence or was murdered

templates.pattern: Woman enters restaurant, orders soup, tastes it, and immediately leaves crying. Why?
templates.explanation: Soup tasted like one made by deceased loved one. Triggered emotional memory

templates.pattern: Two people are born at exact same time to same mother but aren't twins. Already said 'triplets'. What else?
templates.explanation: Born at same time but different years (time zones, daylight saving, or born at midnight on timezone border)

templates.pattern: Man throws something and it returns without bouncing or being caught. What is it?
templates.explanation: Boomerang (classic), or anchor on rope (pulls it back)

templates.pattern: Person dies in plane crash in mountains. Rescuers find body weeks later. But person died of drowning. How?
templates.explanation: Person survived crash but was trapped with melting snow/ice. Drowned in accumulated water

templates.pattern: Man turns off light and kills 200 people. Who is he?
templates.explanation: Lighthouse keeper turns off lighthouse light. Ship crashes, killing 200 people

templates.pattern: Identical twins, one tells only truth, one only lies. You can ask one question to one twin to identify which is which. What question?
templates.explanation: Ask 'Would your twin say you are the truth-teller?' Truth-teller says no (twin would lie). Liar says yes (lying about what twin would say)

templates.pattern: Man condemned to death can choose room. Room 1: firing squad. Room 2: lions not fed for 3 months. Room 3: fire. Which should he choose?
templates.explanation: Room 2. Lions not fed for 3 months would be dead from starvation

templates.pattern: Man afraid of flying takes train. Train crashes. He survives but dies. Autopsy shows death by drowning. Train didn't go near water. How?
templates.explanation: Train carried water tank or fish cargo that burst in crash, drowning him in the wreckage
